**🐛 Fix release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

"Start with a new chat" now actually brings the panel to the front on mobile — the conversation opens over the editor, no swipe needed.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Right sidebar expands**: revealing the view was not enough on the phone; the panel stayed behind a closed right drawer. M.I.L.A now expands the right split so the chat comes forward.
- **Reveal after layout**: on mobile Obsidian re-activates the last note right after the layout is ready, which pushed the panel back. The reveal now runs a tick later, so it lands on top.
- **Unchanged when off**: leaving the option on "Dashboard" keeps the previous behaviour.

### 🔧 Fixes & Quality
- Both changes are confined to the startup path; toggling options in Settings and the ribbon/command still open the panel the same way.
